requiredBehaviors.behavior: derive and version recipient scope from distribution and consignee evidence rather than CRM alone
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Recipient scope is reconciled from distribution, shipment, consignee, service and contact evidence with explicit gaps.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep sent delivered acknowledged and action-evidenced states separate for every recipient
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The communication state machine separates each external evidence state.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: bind each communication event to the actual controlled notice version and evidence
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Every event carries notice version, channel, timestamps only when evidenced and append-only history.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: handoff unresolved recipients downstream distribution and verified response states to medical-device-field-action-effectiveness
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The effectiveness handoff includes population, communication evidence, downstream state and unresolved gaps.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat a mailing list as proof of complete affected population
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Mailing/CRM lists are inputs only, not completeness proof.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: mark recipients informed solely because messages were dispatched
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Dispatch is distinct from delivery and acknowledgement.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: claim required customer action is complete from acknowledgement alone
